runtimeRequirement.notes: PowerShell 7.4 or newer and read access to the configured local file are required.

derivedFrom.guidance: Record the upstream template/version/digest, use a stable sourceId instead of hashing host paths, and bump evidence normalization when the file shape or comparison changes.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers stable source ID, field, expected and observed values, match state, and document version. An unchanged file returns idle.

semantics.terminal: This continuing local condition never returns terminal; remove or pause it when the condition no longer matters.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from source ID and normalized cursor. Recipients must deduplicate repeated event IDs.

credentials.policy: No credential environment variables are used. File authorization is the operating-system identity of the trusted Watcher process.

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: Only current file contents are observable and intermediate writes can be lost; ten recommended intervals is the conservative bound.
